summary:
Complete guide to running Qwen 2.5 Coder 3B Abliterated WITHOUT Ollama. Covers 6 alternatives:

1. HuggingFace Transformers (Python — best for SmartAGENT integration)
2. llama-cpp-python (lightweight C++ backend with Python bindings)
3. vLLM (high-performance inference server)
4. LM Studio (GUI app, no code needed)
5. ExLlamaV2 (fastest inference)
6. Text Generation WebUI (web interface)

Each option includes full install commands, ready-to-run code, and pros/cons. Recommended pick: HuggingFace Transformers for direct integration into the SmartAGENT Python project.
